Most modern board games begin with a quick teach during which experienced players explain the rules to newcomers. The depth of this teach varies widely depending on the complexity of the game and the patience of those involved. A clear, concise teach can make the difference between a delightful first session and a frustrating one. Veteran players often develop a personal style; some begin with the win condition, others with the turn structure, and the most thoughtful adapt their explanation to the group at hand.
